original_regional_context.display_method_note: Separate context: the climatological jet has a reported 200 km meridional scale from Japan to 165°E. Different temporal and geographic supports; no 100–200 km seasonal range. Farther downstream, shifts of the narrow jet broaden its long-term mean. January 2005 illustrates a monthly SSH field; 60–120 cm contours locate the axis search region, not width edges.
